name: signalk-pypilot-newui
description: Signal K friendly UI for the pypilot autopilot, with the capability to spread its functions and buttons to other programs like KIP, WilhelmSK and freeboard. Touch-first mobile visor + full pypilot data (servo, gains, calibration, tack, warnings) as first-class Signal K paths and Simple Switches. Coexists with pypilot-autopilot-provider.

screenshots.title: Control - compass rose with concentric target + wind arrows (amber A = apparent wind, teal T = true wind), hull-fixed sailing wedges, 4 configurable corner tiles, big-touch AP button and heading trim buttons
Chart - Trip Stats cards (AP engaged time, distance, energy, RMS/p95 heading error, servo runtime, tacks/gybes, max servo A) plus live Servo Health with baseline, recent average, deviation and peak
Tune - PID gain sliders per pilot/profile with plain-language help ('act now reflex', 'closes sustained drift'), locked by default with orange 'was:' baseline, +/-10 and +/-1 fine-tune buttons
Trips - auto-recorded outings summarised with distance, duration, average SOG/TWS, tack count and peak speeds; tap to open the OpenSeaMap trace and share as PNG or WhatsApp
Chart - history window with hover-freeze showing HDG cmd, HDG act, AWA, SOG and Servo A at any point of the timeline
Tack history - persistent per-tack log with best retention and fastest recovery highlighted, filterable by day range
